long_biography.plain_text:
NR Sports began managing Neymar’s image while he was still in Santos’s youth system. Founded by his parents when he was fourteen, the company built commercial partnerships around the player’s emerging reputation and later retained the commercial rights to his image. That structure allowed athletic performance and endorsement work to develop as coordinated but distinct income streams.

On the field, Santos provided the platform for a teenage professional debut and major Brazilian and continental titles. Barcelona added a Champions League victory, while Paris Saint-Germain made him the subject of football’s record transfer. Brazil supplied Olympic gold. The Instituto Projeto Neymar Jr became the enduring social expression of that commercial reach, combining education, sport and family support in Praia Grande.

uncertainties.detail: Santos FC and CBF consistently give Neymar da Silva Santos Júnior as the legal full name. The dossier corrects the display name, first name and suffix so the database can reproduce that order, while retaining the existing compound family-name field rather than speculatively reallocating Portuguese surname particles into middle-name fields.

The immutable Female value is a clear source-data error. Multiple exact-person official club, federation, career-management and Forbes sources identify Neymar as male, so the correction is proposed at confidence 100 rather than left as an unresolved conflict.

The ontology has no professional-earner category. Operator is selected because Neymar personally performs and licenses the athletic and image work that creates the core income, while the management company was founded and is run by his parents; Founder would incorrectly assign him creation of NR Sports.

The fortune derives from Neymar's own football career and brand rather than inherited assets. His father's football background and his parents' early creation of NR Sports were meaningful support, but the public evidence does not cleanly establish whether that support crosses the ontology's substantial-advantage threshold, so broad Self-made avoids overstatement.

No LinkedIn profile was proposed. The official X handle and personal website have first-party platform or institutional cross-links. The Instagram handle has very high rather than absolute confidence because the platform page could not be fetched directly, although current NR Sports material and long-established official brand sources consistently identify the account.
